command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -i -E "cli|eval" | head -30; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -80; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -120

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | tail -30; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -60

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals
cat > .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arith
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: arith
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_adds
    title: uses add for a sum
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
echo '{"mcpServers":{"arith":{"url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}}}' > .mcp.json
$M cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml 2>&1 | tail -5
env | grep -c ANTHROPIC; $M test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --reporter junit-xml --out reports/arith.xml 2>&1 | tail -25

cd /workspace; echo $MCPJAM_API_URL; env | grep -i -E "^(ANTHROPIC|MCPJAM)" | sed 's/=.*key.*/=<redacted>/I' | cut -c1-60; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval --help 2>&1 | head -30; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md | grep -i -n -E "http://|insecure|allow" | head
cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M cloud eval run --help 2>&1 | head -50; $M cloud eval create --help 2>&1 | head -40

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M cloud whoami 2>&1 | head -c 500; echo; $M cloud servers list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; $M cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --project project_fixture --server arith --wait --reporter json-summary --out reports/arith.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1800

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; sed -i 's/- name: arith/- name: Arithmetic/' .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml; $M cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --project project_fixture --server Arithmetic --wait --reporter json-summary --out reports/arith.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1800; ls reports; head -c 1500 reports/arith.json

cd /workspace; for p in cli/reference sdk/concepts/running-evals cli/ci; do curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/$p.md | grep -n -i -E "kind: *toolCall|kind: tool|toolCall" | head -8; done; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -i -E "suite|schema|format" | head
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | sed -n 1800,1830p; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | sed -n 2440,2500p

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; python3 - <<'E'
p='.mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('    steps:')
s=s[:i]+'''    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: toolCall
        serverName: Arithmetic
        toolName: add
        arguments:
          a: 17
          b: 25
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
$M cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --project project_fixture 2>&1 | tail -c 1200

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; mkdir -p reports; $M cloud eval run --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --project project_fixture --wait --reporter json-summary --out reports/arith.json 2>&1 | tail -c 1500; head -c 1200 reports/arith.json
